select
from bus_funds_investment_balance where delflag_ = '1' order by investment_balance_time desc limit 1

select * from (select * from bus_funds_investment_balance where investment_balance_time between CONCAT(#{year},'-01-01 00:00:00') and CONCAT(#{year},'-03-31 23:59:59') and status='1' order by investment_balance_time desc limit 1 ) a union ALL select * from (select * from bus_funds_investment_balance where investment_balance_time between CONCAT(#{year},'-04-01 00:00:00' )and CONCAT(#{year},'-06-30 23:59:59')and status='1' order by investment_balance_time desc limit 1 ) b union ALL select * from (select * from bus_funds_investment_balance where investment_balance_time between CONCAT(#{year},'-07-01 00:00:00') and CONCAT(#{year},'-09-30 23:59:59')and status='1' order by investment_balance_time desc limit 1 ) c union all select * from (select * from bus_funds_investment_balance where investment_balance_time between CONCAT(#{year},'-10-01 00:00:00') and CONCAT(#{year},'-12-31 23:59:59')and status='1' order by investment_balance_time desc limit 1 ) d

select bfib.investment_balance_time as investmentBalanceTime, bfib.real_estate_balance AS realEstateBalance, bfib.foreign_balance AS foreignBalance, bfib.other_finance_balance AS otherFinanceBalance, bfib.unlisted_limit as unlistedLimit, bfib.real_estate_limit AS realEstateLimit, bfib.foreign_limit AS foreignLimit, bfib.other_finance_limit AS otherFinanceLimit, bfib.unlisted_balance AS unlistedBalance, bfib.all_investment_balance As allInvestmentBalance, bfib.insurance_management_balance as insuranceManagementBalance, bfib.bank_financial_balance as bankFinancialBalance, bfib.bank_negotiable_securities_balance as bankNegotiableSecuritiesBalance, bfib.trust_scheme_balance as trustSchemeBalance, bfib.negotiable_securities_special_plan_balance as negotiableSecuritiesSpecialPlanBalance, bfib.insurance_funds_support_plan_balance as insuranceFundsSupportPlanBalance, bfib.other_investment_balance as otherInvestmentBalance, bfib.financial_products as financialProducts, bfib.balance_investment as balanceInvestment, bfib.balance_investment_limit as balanceInvestmentLimit from bus_funds_investment_balance bfib where bfib.investment_balance_time =( select max(bb.investment_balance_time) from bus_funds_investment_balance bb) and bfib.status = '1'

select * from bus_funds_investment_balance where DELFLAG_ = '1' and DATE_FORMAT(investment_balance_time, '%Y-%m-%d') between #{quarterBeginDate} and #{quarterEndDate} order by investment_balance_time desc limit 1
